content: Begere be ana orosa kane surǝa dizi
Malo ngmenga Yeso a Baitalami o makeke ma Yahudiya, awere togomo te Hiridus ogomo Ogong, ana orosa ne surea adizi nane deya a Urushalima ane pirkǝ na,
“Ondooka a ngmeng, ogomo ma Yahuda ya babaa? Te laka bewerewere be wai a dizi na te deya kate eze kai makili ma Ashili.”
Nangka Ogomo Hiridus wa kone nyimi nawa kone oburǝ ka apate aromo a Urushalima.
Nawa kurki pate andaamoole magame ma Ashili ka ana obaala angmǝ aka Ashili a nya Mosa, awa pirkǝ ne na, a ruwǝme abena aya ngmenga Kiristi?
Nane kabare wai na, “Apeng Betalami a makeke ma Yahudiya,” Ane kang bena, “Nyimia ondo obeya angmǝ ka mawo ma Ashili wa wele,

content.text: ota baate ne a nyimi makeke ma togomo ma Yahudiya,
ka ogomo yo surǝa nyimi au ka waya eza togomo

content: Na Hiridus rare ana orosa name asuk adorana wa rose awere aka bewerewere beme be suri.
Nawa tong ne a Betalami na, “Ale na ka esoole kena kame a dede. Eedate ka ecǝ kai, deyana ka ebeleng, adorana mima ang ale kang eze makili ma Ashili a begeshe be kai.”
Malooka ne mara okona angmǝ ogomo, nane lya izi ka teweno tene, a bewerewere beeka be surǝ ane obora kale ane ba izi a ale araaka kena kame zane.
Nangka ne laka bewerewere beme, nane pene ka okona oleba maleu.

Ko lyǝ a kwilǝ me ane laka kena kame ka iini kai Mariya, nane girwǝ aa ne eze kai makili ma Ashili. Zaa nyimi nane pǝri majeketa ma emate mane ane nya kai magogoro, mazenare, madangku ma lubban kaa ma omur.
Aza obena Obere Ashili wa windi ne toto a nyimi tolau na tana ne kuri ara Hiridus ne, nane tare orona yende a kurǝ a makeke mane.
O alea wogo a Masar

Malooka ana orosa me ne ale, otoma Ashili o dera lepung wa suri a Yusupu a tolau. Awa bekaana, “Era o ana kena kame ka iini kai o alea wogo a Masar. Oo cikǝ a saname seena ba kone eyapa mi, aza obena Hiridus ya gera kena kame kawa wong kai.”
Na Yusupu ere a lelyaare leme, nawa ana kena kame ka iini kai a alea Masar,
arakanamea ne cikǝ ne a ale ogwǝ o Hiridus. Nyimi apanza angmǝ Ashili ka a beke o ngmǝ otoma ai o lepung na, “Ma rare kena kang ka ka suri a Masar.”
O wongha a bana ayana a Masar

Nangka Hiridus wa laka obena ana orosa ne kala wai a izi, na o nyong caro wai maleu. Nawa ote na a wongze pate ayana a batebate alome ka neya Betalami ka oringǝri o ai, aa deya senai se leere aa jǝpi, a akap nangka ne kone ara ana orosa name.
Awere namea angmǝ Ashili ka Irimiya beke a pena na,

content.text: lengmelo le okona oburǝ ka oruuzi a jǝng,
Rahila ya ruuzi azaa ayana kai

content: O surǝ a Masar a ale a Nazarat
Malooka Hiridus wa gbwi, na otoma Ashili o dera lepung deya a Yusupu a nyimi tolau a Masar
awa bekaana, “Era, ka o ana kena ka iini kai o ale a makeke ma Isrela, andaaka neya yeme o wongnga kena kame ne gbwizǝ.”
Nawa ere, aa wa ana kena kame ka iini kai aa wa ale a makeke ma Isrela.
Nangka wa kone obena oyana o Hiridus, Arkilayus wa zala togomo a bengmǝ ba ate wai, nawa kone boome bo ale a saname. Azaa obena a windi wai teto a nyimi tolau, nawa dare awa ale a makeke ma Galili,
Wa ale nawa cikǝ a kapeng ka yende ka a rareze kai na Nazarat. Adorana apanza angmǝ Ashili ka ana obeya a ngmǝ ka mawo ma Ashili ne beke, “Ayo rara kai karomo ka Nazarat.”
